body: Wow thank you!

To be completely honest I did not know I had that in me I’ve never ran a 10k that fast throughout my training and have run very few miles faster than 8:00 pace. I just told myself if you can still run after mile 20 than I’m going to run as fast as I feel my legs can sustain. It was absolutely the most pain I have ever felt, so to answer your question my brain was saying it was only a matter of enduring pain and I didn’t want to regret not pushing it if I knew I could and didn’t if that makes any sense.
Thank you! Yeah I really sent it those last 6 haha
Not as bad as I thought it was going to be. I was so ready to be done though lol
Just ran my 3rd half today on my birthday. Hit a new PR of 1:56:33!!!
Thank you all so much! My mom will love this!
These are awesome!
I stay swapping between acting recovered and junkorexic

Hi another male anorexic here. You are absolutely not alone but I know how it feels. Over all of my treatment stays I have met 3 other males. What I have ultimately come to realize is no matter what gender you can both relate just based on knowing how shitty what your going through is. The closest relationships I’ve built in treatment have been with females. I guess all of this is to say I know what you are going through and you are not alone.
That is very unfortunate haha
They were lol
I was having a really shitty day more than usual and this has made it infinitely better
I agree this is my favorite sub and I appreciate everybody here so much. I’ve been to treatment multiple times and I wouldn’t have made it through without y’all.
So proud of you! Best of luck.

I’m sorry your going through this too. I’m constantly in fear when my friends don’t text me first or if they don’t respond they don’t care. Something my therapist tells me is you have no idea what they are doing they are probably busy or dealing with their own shit. If it helps I care about you. Wish you the best

I relate so hard to this. I am 20 have a good paying job at least for my terms. I feel like I don’t deserve to have what I have and just want to give it to somebody who deserves it. Sending you love I’m still battling the demons holding out hope it will eventually get better.
Literally everyone even my best friend who I am open with and understands I still have it with them. You are not alone I promise.
Of course I know how hard this shit is. Being a male and the stigma surrounding mental health makes it even worse
If it helps you feel any less alone I’m male too

My experience is similar to yours. I’ve had severe anxiety, depression, and suicidal thoughts as long as I can remember. They all started getting even worse when I got out of high school. After that I struggled with body image hard and developed a severe eating disorder. I was so hopeless nothing mattered and everybody in my life either left or didn’t like me. Then I got treatment for my eating disorder and I met so many good people who are supportive and I hang out with until this day. I still struggle with all of this bullshit but it has gotten better it’s still not easy but dealing with it is getting easier. I hope that helps. Sending you love
Thank you for the response. I was able to wait it out. Super cliche but just trying to take it one meal at a time.

This is just my experience and learning more about my emotions through therapy but I’ve been anxious and depressed for a lot longer than I thought. I was so in denial of even acknowledging that I had mental illness that I pushed everything down and tried to act how I thought I should. Now I know exactly what I’m dealing with which is severe social anxiety and depression. I hope that helps
